blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) turned over a community water depot to the local government of the island municipality of Alabat in Quezon province on Nov. 7, to help residents cope with water shortages caused by El Niño. The water depot has a storage capacity of 4,000 liters of clean water, which residents can access amid the prolonged dry spell, the DSWD Region IV-A said in a report. “We are having a hard time dealing with El Niño because our wells are drying up and our water supply is unstable.
